content.text:
I submitted **index 2 (Nb 0.467 / V 0.533)**. At 5.64 µA it has the highest photocurrent of the three compositions I measured.

| Index | Nb fraction | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | 0.72 | 1.63 µA |
| 7 | 0.45 | 5.51 µA |
| 2 | 0.467 | 5.64 µA |

- **Trend:** photocurrent goes up about 3.5 times as the film gets richer in vanadium (V).
- **Structure:** X-ray diffraction (XRD) on indices 7, 0 and 13 (Nb 0.45 to 0.59) shows the same crystal structure throughout. Index 0 has one small extra peak. So photocurrent probably changes smoothly across this range rather than jumping at a phase change.
- **Uncertainty:** indices 2 and 7 differ by only 0.13 µA, which may be within measurement noise. Both are at the V-rich end, where the best result is expected. The other 12 compositions were never measured, so one of them could still be slightly better, but the trend makes that unlikely.

All 3 merit measurements were used. 3 of the 5 XRD measurements were used.
